notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Herd Baloth.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
